requirements.item_text: The quality agreement with a contract facility sets out in detail how the quality units of both parties work together so that products are made in compliance with GMP.

mappings.quote: The section of a quality agreement that addresses each party’s quality unit activities should define in detail how the parties will work together to ensure that products are manufactured in compliance with CGMP.

requirements.item_text: The quality agreement with a contract facility is clear about how product release is handled.

mappings.quote: In particular, this section of the quality agreement should be clear with respect to product release.

requirements.item_text: The contract facility approves or rejects the products and results of its own manufacturing operations, such as test results, in-process materials or finished dosage forms.

mappings.quote: Contract facilities are responsible for approving or rejecting the product or results of their manufacturing operations (e.g., test results, finished dosage forms, or in-process materials).

requirements.item_text: The quality agreement describes how and when the owner and contract facility communicate, both verbally and in writing, and names the contact people in each organisation.

mappings.quote: Within its quality unit activities, a quality agreement should describe how and when the owner and contract facility will communicate with each other, both verbally and in writing. This includes identifying appropriate contact personnel within the owner’s and contract facility’s organization.

requirements.item_text: The quality agreement covers audits, inspections and how findings are communicated.

mappings.quote: Quality agreements should also cover audits, inspections, and communication of findings.
It should include the parties’ agreed-upon provisions for communicating inspection observations and findings, as well as relevant FDA actions and correspondence.
mappings.addendum: The agreement also sets out how relevant regulatory actions and correspondence are shared between the parties.

mappings.quote: Because contract facilities often provide services to multiple owners, the quality agreement should address when, how, and what information the contractor will report to owners about objectionable conditions observed during inspections and audits of the contract facility.
mappings.addendum: It states when, how and what the contract facility reports to the owner about objectionable conditions found during inspections and audits of its site.

requirements.item_text: The quality agreement allows the owner to evaluate and audit the contract facility for GMP compliance of specific operations, through both routine and for-cause audits.

mappings.quote: The agreement should allow owners to evaluate and audit contract facilities to ensure CGMP compliance for specific operations. This provision should cover both routine quality audits and for-cause audits.

requirements.item_text: The quality agreement sets out what the owner and contract facility expect for regulatory pre-approval, routine surveillance and for-cause inspections, taking the products or services involved into account.

mappings.quote: The agreement should also set owner and contract facility expectations regarding FDA inspections (pre-approval, routine surveillance, and for-cause) with consideration for the nature of the products to be manufactured and/or services to be provided.

requirements.item_text: Where a distributor or its agent hands an activity to a subcontractor, that subcontractor holds the proper authorisation for the activity and works to standards equal to the distributor's own.

mappings.quote: If the activity of a distributor or his or her agent is subcontracted to another entity, the person or entity to which the activity is subcontracted shall be appropriately authorized to perform the subcontracted activity and shall uphold the same standards as the distributor.

requirements.item_text: Contract acceptors are audited at regular intervals.

mappings.quote: There shall be periodic audit of contract acceptors.

requirements.item_text: The contract with the contract acceptor sets out how starting materials, intermediates, bulk and finished products are dealt with if they are rejected.

mappings.quote: The contract shall describe the handling of starting materials, intermediate, bulk and finished products, if they are rejected.
The contract shall describe the handling of starting materials, intermediate, bulk and finished products, if they are rejected.

requirements.item_text: The contract sets out the steps to follow when contract testing shows that the product tested has to be rejected.

mappings.quote: It shall also describe the procedure to be followed if the contract analysis shows that the tested product must be rejected.
It shall also describe the procedure to be followed if the contract analysis shows that the tested product must be rejected.

requirements.item_text: For phytopharmaceuticals, the technical parts of every contract are prepared by competent persons with suitable knowledge of the particular characteristics of these products, including how they are produced and tested in quality control.

mappings.quote: Technical aspects of the contract shall be drawn up by the competent persons suitably knowledgeable on the specific characteristics of Phytopharmaceuticals, including their production and quality control testing.
